name: Umar ibn al-Khattab
nameAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه

laqab.en: al-Faruq; Amir al-Mu'minin (the first to bear the title)

deathVariants.authority: killed in Dhu al-Hijja 23 (Taqrib; Ibn Hajar: "this is the soundest"); al-Khazraji: martyred at the end of 23 and buried at the start of 24

bio: The second caliph, born about forty years before the hijra by the usual estimate and assassinated in Dhu al-Hijja 23 AH. He delivered this hadith from the pulpit of the Prophet's mosque, which is where Alqama heard it.
